The plate is a square plate of roughly 26 cm. On it are about 4 pieces of pineapple (yellow) and 3 pieces of honeydew melon (pale green).

The pineapple chunks are about 2.5 cm each, roughly 10-12 g apiece, so about 45 g in total. At about 50 kcal per 100 g, that is roughly 23 kcal.

The melon pieces are slightly larger, about 15 g each, so about 45 g in total. At about 36 kcal per 100 g, that is roughly 16 kcal.

The total is about 90 g and about 40 kcal. The pieces may be a little thicker than they look from above, so I'll round up to about 100 g and 45 kcal.
